external_games.name: Waxy: The Wick and The Witch

name: Waxy: The Wick and The Witch
storyline: Waxy: The Wick and The Witch begins when Waxy, a young man, falls victim to a curse cast by a witch that transforms him into a living candle. Trapped in the mysterious and enchanted house of the witch, the protagonist must use his ingenuity and his own flame to explore the magical rooms and solve challenging platform puzzles. Now Waxy is on the desperate search for the witch's wand, the only item capable of reversing the spell, while Waxy races against time to avoid melting completely.
summary:
Welcome to Waxy: The Wick and the Witch, a magical adventure where you play as a candle exploring the attic of a witch’s house.
This is a third-person 3D puzzle platformer that challenges you to master the power of fire while managing your wax before it melts away.
